listen_port.description: TCP port on which Powerman listens for client connections (HTTP and RPC).

log_level.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, notice, warn, error, critical).

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to use syslog.

auth_required.description: Require HTTP Basic authentication for web/RPC access.

auth_file.description: Path to htpasswd file containing usernames and passwords (SHA or MD5 hash).

device_retries.description: Number of retries before a device operation is considered failed.

status_poll_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between automatic status polling of devices.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS/TLS for the Powerman web interface.

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (used only if SSL is enabled).

ssl_private_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (used only if SSL is enabled).

devices.description: List of physical devices (PDU, UPS, IPMI, etc.) to manage.

name.description: Unique device name (used internally and in logs).

type.description: Device type: pdu, ups, ipmi, snmp, apc, baytech, raritan, etc.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the device.

port.description: Management port (e.g., 23 for telnet, 161 for SNMP, 623 for IPMI).

password.description: Password for authentication (optional, stored in config — consider permissions).

model.description: Device model string (e.g., 'APC SmartSlot', 'Raritan PX2') for protocol tweaks.

timeout.description: Override default timeout for this device (seconds). Optional.

members.description: List of device names or node names included in this node (supports nesting).

resources.description: Named collections of outlets (for group control, e.g., 'all_servers').

type.description: Resource type — currently only 'outlet' is supported.

device.description: Name of the device containing the outlet.

outlets.description: List of outlet references (device:outlet) in this resource.

acls.description: Access control rules (who can perform which actions on which resources).

action.description: Allowed action: on, off, cycle, status, config, admin.

resource.description: Name of the resource this ACL grants access to.

user.description: Single allowed user (if group not specified).
